# The files whose change can change a picture of scripts/screenshots.sh, as the paths
# of a workflow: * stays within a folder, ** goes through folders, and a line that
# starts with ! leaves files out. After a push to main that touches one of them, the
# screenshot bot (screenshot-bot.yml) renders the pictures; it always watches the
# script and this list. The visual check of pull requests (visual.yml) watches the
# same files.

# The app: what it shows, in which words, and its icons.
appinfo/**
css/**
img/**
js/**
l10n/**
lib/**
templates/**

# The demo that the pictures show: Nextcloud, the mock of Paperless and its
# documents, the real Paperless in which the account of the search is set up, and the
# browser with the steps that it takes.
tests/e2e/compose.yaml
tests/e2e/compose.paperless.yaml
tests/e2e/mock_server.py
tests/e2e/pdf.py
tests/e2e/package.json
tests/e2e/package-lock.json
tests/e2e/run.sh
tests/e2e/screenshots.mjs
tests/e2e/demo.mjs
tests/e2e/ui.mjs

# The social preview, which shows the first screenshot.
.github/social-preview.html
.github/social-preview/Dockerfile
